deadlines.notes: GBP 8,000 a year (up to GBP 24,000 over three years). Open to overseas fee payers who already hold an offer for an undergraduate degree starting September 2027; apply through the form in the Bath Application Tracker. The page gives no clock time.

deadlines.label: Bath International Excellence Scholarship, round 2 closes
deadlines.notes: Same scheme and conditions as round 1. The page gives no clock time.

english_policy.waiver_notes: A suitable English language qualification is needed only if you do not meet the GCSE English requirement (GCSE English Language or Literature grade 4/C, or equivalent). Category C (lowest band, used for Computer Science and Mechanical Engineering); Economics needs Category B (IELTS 7.0 with 6.5 in each component).

english.notes: Category C (Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering). Category B (Economics): 7.0 overall, 6.5 in each component.
Old 0-120 scale (tests up to 21 January 2026). Category C. Category B (Economics): 100 overall, 24 in each component.
New 1-6 scale (tests after 21 January 2026). Category C. Category B (Economics): 5 overall, 4.5 in each component.
PTE Academic, Category C. Category B (Economics): 69 overall, 62 in each element. PTE Academic Online is not accepted.
Category C: 120 overall for tests taken after 1 July 2024, with sub scores of Speaking 110, Writing 110, Reading 110, Listening 105. Category B (Economics): 130 overall.

tier_notes.general: Complete University Guide 2027 overall ranking: 9th of 130 UK universities (A = ranks 6-15 on the national scale).
